newsitem.title: UK: BNG could launch jumbo dlr bond this week -bankers.
newsitem.headline: BNG could launch jumbo dlr bond this week -bankers.

text.p: Bank Nederlandse Gemeenten (BNG) could launch a five-year dollar bond for up to $1.0 billion this week, bankers said on Monday.
The triple-A rated Dutch bank, which funds local authorities, has completed roadshows.
ABN AMRO Hoare Govett, Goldman Sachs and Nomura International have a mandate to underwrite a transaction, but officials there said the terms of the deal had not yet been set.
But bankers elsewhere said a five-year dollar bond was expected as early as Wednesday. The expected size ranged between $750 million and $1.0 billion.
Spread talk was around 10 basis points over U.S. Treasury notes.
BNG officials said earlier this month they wanted to borrow more from Asian investors. This group of buyers have been big takers of recent five-year dollar bonds.
